blocks.text: The 74th edition of the Filipino Academy of Movie Arts and Sciences (Famas) Awards hailed Maricel Soriano and McCoy de Leon as its respective Best Actress and Best Actor awardees, while Maris Racal received the inaugural Actress of Distinction accolade. The Diamond Star was honored for her role in “Meet, Greet, Bye,” while Racal earned the recognition for her performance in “Sunshine.” De Leon took home the best actor award for his performance in “In Thy Name,” which won several categories at the awards event including the Best Picture, Best Director for Cesar Soriano, and Best Visual Effects for Gaspar Mangain.
